lines.en: I took these pictures on my trip last month.
Wow! Is that a stone tower, Grandma?
Yes. It's an old tower with a round roof.
lines.ko: 네. 둥근 지붕이 있는 오래된 탑이에요.

lines.en: How did people build it in those days?
They cut stones by hand. It was difficult then.
What is this? It has many columns.
That's a sculpture hall. I love its architecture.
lines.ko: 그건 조각 전시실이에요. 그 건축이 정말 좋아요.

lines.en: The structure looks strong and simple.
Next year we will visit it together.
I can't wait! Thank you, Grandma.
Excuse me. Who is this statue?
This is a statue of a famous teacher, Ma'am.
It's made of stone, isn't it?
Yes. The sculpture is two hundred years old.
lines.ko: 네. 이 조각은 이백 년이 됐어요.

lines.en: The tower behind it is very high.
People built the tower long ago. It was difficult.
lines.ko: 사람들이 오래전에 탑을 지었어요. 어려운 일이었어요.

lines.en: The architecture is beautiful. May I take a picture?
Sure. It looks best from the left side.
Thank you. I will send it to my grandson.
He will love it. Have a nice day.
lines.ko: 손자가 좋아할 거예요. 좋은 하루 보내세요.
